_comment: Dependency advisories the developer has explicitly accepted, read by scripts/security-check.sh (via scripts/lib/security-parse.mjs). An entry only applies to development-only dependencies — a production advisory always fails the gate — and only until its reviewBy date, after which the gate fails again and the advisory must be re-reviewed. Adding or extending an entry is a security decision: it must be approved by the developer and recorded in the release's security report. JSON has no comment syntax, hence this field.

accepted.reason: Stack-exhaustion denial of service on deeply nested glob patterns. Development-only lint tooling, never installed in production (npm audit --omit=dev is clean). No fixed braces release exists; npm audit's suggested fix is a downgrade to eslint-config-next 14, which isn't viable.
